_comment:
'**Instant** - Destroy this: Discard a card. Gain {r} equal to its pitch value.' + printed **Battleworn**. Necromancer Equipment - Chest.

SHAPE COPIED FROM SHIPPED dyn/ornate_tessen.json - the same 'Instant - <destroy cost>: ...' equipment activation (INSTANT ability, cost array, effects after). INSTANT abilities of chest equipment are offered by play._add_hero_dsl_activations (play.py:258-265 scans head/chest/arms/legs) at any priority window with no action point (play.py:284 gates only ACTIVATE).

ACTIVATION_COST 0 declared explicitly per DSL_REFERENCE ('use 0 for free abilities') - the whole cost is destroying this, which is the ability-level DESTROY_SELF cost (cost_types.py:43-51: always payable, pays via canonical destroy(), which resolves the chest slot itself). It is a COST, not an effect, so it can block the activation.

DISCARD WITH A CHOICE, per triage: LOOK_AT zone HAND player SELF amount ALL into 'hand_cards' peeks WITHOUT moving (effect_types.py:3356-3415); player SELF must be explicit because the handler defaults to OPPONENT (:3380). SELECT_FROM_REF mode ANY min 1 max 1 into 'discarded' makes the controller choose exactly one (STOP is only offered once the minimum is met, effect_types.py:3578-3587). MOVE_REF ref 'discarded' to_zone graveyard moves it via canonical put_object (player defaults to OWNER, :3441), which is the discard. An empty hand degrades gracefully: the refs stay empty, nothing moves, no gain - the destroy cost was still paid, and the text gives the activation no minimum-hand condition.

PITCH-VALUE GAIN AS BRANCHES: no amount expression reads a ref's pitch value (effect_types._resolve_amount has COUNT_REF but it COUNTS matching cards, it does not return pitch), so 'gain {r} equal to its pitch value' is spelled as three CONDITIONAL branches on REF_PITCH_IS pitch 1/2/3 - the exact pattern of .drafts/dabble_in_darkness_red.json. REF_PITCH_IS unwraps a single-element ref list (condition_types.py:1995-2008), so the one chosen card tests directly; a card with no pitch value tests 0 against 1/2/3 and no branch fires.

BATTLEWORN NOT AUTHORED: printed keyword on the card DB keywords field, implemented engine-side - re-authoring it would be a defect.

SET FOLDER AT ADOPTION: derive from the card's sets/setIdentifiers in card_data/slug_index.json (batch says ArmoryDeckGravyBones), never from its class.
